verify.corrections:
1. Logical operators in the object (Designer-expression) part: only `not` / `!` is an operator. Logical AND/OR are functions: functions page "Usage: and(x, y)" and "Usage: or(x, y)" (https://help.disguise.one/designer/configuration/expressions/functions, verify_expr_syntax/functions.txt lines 1567, 1590); operators page "Logical operator ... not ! - (!a) flip the truth value" (verify_expr_syntax/operators.txt 1517-1523). Do not write infix `a and b` in objectPath; write `and(a, b)`.

2. Row 29 (Machine): `object.hostname` is writable in Python -- d3.pyi:24024-24029 "def hostname(self) -> str: ... @hostname.setter def hostname(self, value: str) -> None". `object.name` (d3.pyi:24063-24065) has no setter and is read-only. For a Companion preset the read-only use is still the sensible one, but mark hostname as "settable (do not expose)".

3. Row 23 (TransportManager strings): both `statusString` (d3.pyi:51528-51535, "@statusString.setter") and `monitorString` (d3.pyi:51373 region, "@monitorString.setter") have setters; only `tcStatusString` (51538) is getter-only. Report said only statusString has a setter.

4. Row 16 addendum: `object.player.playMode.state` is confirmed read-only (PlayMode.state has no setter; docstring d3.pyi:33964-33966 "Play mode of the PlayHead. An enum of the list [Play, PlaySection, LoopSection, Stop, HoldSection, HoldEnd]"; constants at d3.pyi:50163-50168, not 50162-50167). The settable counterpart the report does not list is `TrackPlayer.mode` (int, "@mode.setter def mode(self, mode: int)" in class TrackPlayer @50155); TrackPlayer setters are exactly fadeDurationBeats, loopUxFade, mode, track, trackSection. Whether a LiveUpdate `set` on `object.player.mode` is honoured (vs. needing TransportCommand.makePlayMode + addCommand) is untested.

5. Path/prefix case: the resources guide says "always lowercase" (guides-resources.txt 182-184) but the official useful-strings snippet compares `device.path == 'objects/ExpressionVariablesDevice/PluginVariable.apx'` (class-cased; https://developer.disguise.one/python-api/useful-strings, verify_expr_syntax/useful-strings.txt 167). This strengthens open question 1 (prefix/path case is probably case-insensitive, but no source states it).

6. Track tags: `track.tags` is documented in the track guide (guides-track.txt 171) but in d3.pyi it is only the inherited `Resource.tags -> List[ResourceTag]` (d3.pyi:40524); Track itself exposes `tagsAtBeat(self, iBeat: float) -> List[Tag]` and `cues -> TimeSequence[Cue]` (with setter). Section names for a Stream Deck would come from Tag objects via tagsAtBeat or cues, not from SectionInfo.

7. Minor: rows 19/20 brightness/volume live in class SuperTransportManager(Resource) @48303 (inherited by TransportManager), both with setters -- correct conclusion, imprecise class attribution. Rows 32/33 cite class-header lines (16134/16115/16030) rather than member lines; members and setters (container, variables, name, defaultFloat, defaultString) all exist. r34.0 changelog additionally adds DmxFixtureType, DmxScreen.fixtureType, EventTransportMidiNote.transportSpeedInputType, LayerColourRuleSet.getColourInfo, SuperLayer.anchorAndUpdateRelatedLayers (chg_r34.0.txt 155-276); r33.1 also adds globals dbg, nullopt, packageSystem (chg_r33.1.txt 622-660). None affect the candidate table.

verify.summary: Re-downloaded all 30 cited pages (all 200 except /python-api/execution = 404 as reported) and re-checked every d3.pyi line reference. The report is accurate on the resource-reference grammar, sanitised names, case sensitivity, getByUID, subsystem:/domain: evidence, the Subsystem/Domain subclass lists, the Python 2.7 caveats, every changelog entry (r34.0 through r30.8), and 30 of the 34 candidate rows. Three factual errors: (a) 'and/or' are not infix operators in Designer expressions but functions and(x,y)/or(x,y) (only not/! is an operator); (b) Machine.hostname has a setter (report says read-only); (c) TransportManager.monitorString also has a setter (report says only statusString). One useful omission: TrackPlayer.mode (int) is the settable play-mode property, while playMode.state is read-only. Also flagged: the official useful-strings snippet uses a class-cased path 'objects/ExpressionVariablesDevice/...', contradicting the resources guide's 'always lowercase' rule and reinforcing the open question on prefix case; track.tags is inherited Resource.tags -> List[ResourceTag], with Track.tagsAtBeat/cues being the section-name sources. Remaining open questions in the report stand as stated.

critic.summary: Coverage verdict across the lead's 11 categories, judged only from the verified JSON plus the local module sources I opened (src/feedbacks.ts, src/variables.ts, src/presets.ts, companion/HELP.md, throwaway folder docs/osc-help.md, liveupdate.txt). Nine of eleven categories have at least one doc-verified candidate after verification: Monitoring-Local (fps/GPUProfiler/CPU/GPUMemory/ProcessMemory from the developer guide; Machine/Disk only from the official Grafana dashboard), Monitoring-Remote (only findRemoteMonitor("HOST:d3","fps")), Transport read-only (49/49 supported, ~35 doc-verified on transportManager:default), Track/Section/Layer inspection (56/57 supported), Layer Property Set (key(0).v, enabled, name, tStart/tLength doc-verified), Stage/Screen (screen2:/projector: doc-verified; ledscreen:/dmxscreen:/stage: only inferred), RenderStream (4 documented expressions plus chained members), Failover/d3Net (20 doc-verified members on Machine:"name"/getByUID; everything about 'the local machine/director without a name' is inferred). Two categories have NO doc-verified or inferred LiveUpdate candidate from the research: Connection & Status is instead covered by module-native features nobody cited (feedback 'connectionState' "Connection OK" at src/feedbacks.ts:10-12 and variable connection_status at src/variables.ts:6, both already used by src/presets.ts) plus only-inferred Designer identity values (fo-36 sessionName, fo-38 ReleaseVersion.versionString(), fo-39 state.projectName); Templates was not researched by any dimension and depends on companion_api findings (previewStyle behaviour, $(liveupdate:...) rewriting only inside useVariables textinput fields). Expression Variables is the weakest researched category: all 13 device-variable candidates are inferred because 'expressionvariablesdevice:<name>' appears in no fetched page, set-through-list-subscript is untested, and the 'defaultFloat is the live value' claim rests on one useful-strings snippet. Cross-cutting blockers that gate Phase 1 catalog design: type-prefix casing (transportManager vs transportmanager vs Machine:), whether subsystem:<AnyClass> generalises beyond MonitoringManager/RenderStreamSystem, whether module globals (d3NetManager, state) and bare type names are in the LiveUpdate eval namespace, tRender vs tCurrent, undocumented monitor-name list beyond the verified six, LiveUpdate set semantics on transport brightness/volume/engaged and on scalar sub-fields (object.offset.x, which HELP.md already advertises), and the absence of any LiveUpdate transport command path (play/stop/next section remain REST-only, so parity with companion-module-disguise-osc actions is impossible in this module). Two internal contradictions need the lead's ruling: exprvars marks module:<layer>/object.brightness doc-verified while track_layer rejects 'module:' as an unverified LiveUpdate object path; and HELP.md's own examples (track:track_1 + object.enabled as a Boolean set; ledscreen:myledscreen) are contradicted by the research (SuperTrack/Track has no 'enabled' member in d3.pyi 47975-50140, only enableRender(onOff); 'ledscreen:' is undocumented).

gapsByCategory.detail: No research dimension produced a LiveUpdate candidate for connection state, and none is needed: the module already defines a boolean feedback 'connectionState' named 'Connection OK' (src/feedbacks.ts:10-12) and a 'connection_status' variable (src/variables.ts:6, HELP.md 'Connected'/'Disconnected'), and src/presets.ts already stacks connectionState on every preset. The MODULE FACTS given to researchers omitted this feedback, so no dimension accounted for it. Designer-side identity/status values exist only at inferred confidence: fo-36 subsystem:SessionSystem/object.sessionName, fo-38 ReleaseVersion.versionString(), fo-39 state.projectName, fo-40 state.getDaysLeftDesigner(), fo-41 state.isInShow. Doc-verified fallbacks for a 'which machine am I talking to' button are Machine:"<name>"/object.hostname, object.IP_address, object.name, object.typeName (fo-11..14) but they require the operator to type the machine name. The health-endpoint style states (Connection/Output/Genlock/Devices severities) are reachable only via fo-17, which depends on the d3NetManager global being in the eval namespace (inferred).

gapsByCategory.status: has doc-verified candidates; several units/names unresolved
gapsByCategory.detail: Doc-verified: fps/'Actual' (1,10,60 samples), GPUProfiler/'Total' plus six sub-series (Grafana), CPU/'Total', GPUMemory/'Usage(MB)', ProcessMemory/'Usage (MB)', Machine/five percent series (Grafana only, absent from the help page's Local graph list), Disk/'Read (MB/s)'/'Write (MB/s)' (Grafana only; guide says Disk over LiveUpdate is in development DSOF-20732). Missing from the operator wish-list: dropped/missed frame counters (no MetricMonitor and no LiveUpdate equivalent of /api/session/status/health; FPS is the documented proxy), temperatures (only VFC card temperatures via Machine.vfcTemperature(iSlot)/vfcFPGATemperature(iSlot) in the failover 'missed' list, doc-verified prefix but untested), network (fo-18 Machine.getNetworkAdaptors() comprehension is doc-verified, r33.1+). Genlock indicators exist but were only found by verifiers (Machine.allRequiredOutputsGenlocked(), hasIncomingHouseSyncSignal(), incomingHouseSyncSignal(), syncStatus(iSlot)). Open: monitor names for Output Latency/Frame Latency/PCI-CPU IO/Timer, CPU 'Total' unit (ms per help page vs 'utilisation' per guide), seriesAverage behaviour on unknown title/expired monitor, and that updateFrequency 0 must never be used for monitors (60 Hz pushes) - note src/presets.ts currently ships updateFrequency: 0 on its existing presets.

gapsByCategory.status: one doc-verified candidate; the rest inferred
gapsByCategory.detail: Only mon-remote-fps (findRemoteMonitor("HOST:d3","fps") / seriesAverage("Actual",1)) is doc-verified. Any other remote monitor name (Machine, GPUProfiler, CPU) is inferred (mon-remote-any). Unknowns that block a remote page: whether the Director must call useMonitorByName(nodeName, monitorName, True) before data flows, hostname case sensitivity, whether Machine.nodeName returns the 'HOST:d3' form, and preserveExpiredGraphs() semantics for disconnected nodes.

All 49 candidates supported; doc-verified include player.tRender/tCurrent, playMode.__str__()/state, playing/stopped/holding, sectionPlayMode/loopSectionMode, speed (r34.0+), brightness/volume/engaged/status, track ref + description + trigger_note + lengthInBeats, nSections(), statusString/tcStatusString/preRollMatch, timecode + current.__str__() + statusString + SMPTE_clock_type (LTC only), play_mode (chase config, different enum from live state), setList, deltaTime, remotetransportmode, enableCustomFps. Parity with osc-help.md variables (currentSectionName, nextSectionName, playMode, section elapsed/remaining, timecode position, track name/position, master volume/brightness, bpm) is achievable read-only via tr-25/26, tr-05/06, tr-28/29, tr-34, tr-20/01/03/04, tr-15/16, tr-23; the OSC module's 20+ transport ACTIONS have no LiveUpdate equivalent.

gapsByCategory.status: well covered; four doc/stub conflicts need live tests
gapsByCategory.detail: 56/57 candidates supported; doc-verified: lengthInBeats/lengthInSec/bpm/description/layers/getLeafLayers(VariableVideoModule)/nLayers()/layer names, cueBeats(), nSections(), sectionInfo(i), sectionToBeat(), noteAtBeat(), trigger_note, tc_adjust, beatToTime(), findLayerByName()/layerByName()/getLeafLayers()[0] object paths, layer name/enabled/enabledIncludingParents/tStart/tEnd/tLength/anchored, keyframe v/localT/nKeys, disableSequencing. Blocking conflicts: getLeafLayers() no-arg on Track (pyi SuperTrack requires a Type; doc uses no-arg), nKeys with vs without parentheses in the documented comprehension, no 'layer:' prefix anywhere (name lookup only via findLayerByName chained in the object path or a comprehension), track-name quoting for names with spaces (track:"Track 1" not shown verbatim), sectionLengthBeats taking a cue index rather than a section index. Cue/section table comprehensions and current-section presets need the playhead from the transport dimension (object.track.beatToSection(object.player.tRender)).

gapsByCategory.status: has doc-verified candidates; set semantics and one cross-dimension contradiction unresolved
gapsByCategory.detail: Doc-verified writes: findSequence("pos.x"|"brightness").sequence.key(0).v (the only set shown verbatim in the LiveUpdate doc), object.enabled (r33.1+), object.name, object.tStart, object.tLength; pyi-writable but untested: localT, interpolation, looping, disableSequencing, KeyString.s, KeyResource.r, render/renderEnable (no docstrings). Contradiction to rule on: exprvars 'knob-layer-module-brightness' (module:<layer>/object.brightness) is marked doc-verified from the expressions guide, but track_layer's verifier rejects 'module:' as a LiveUpdate object path (only shown as expression syntax; guide says do not access Module directly) - one of the two must be downgraded. Also unresolved: whether a set on a live Module field persists against per-frame sequencing (keyframe path is the documented persistent write), field decorated names beyond pos.x/pos.y/scale/brightness/opacity/text/red/green/blue, and that anchored layers reject extent changes. Verifier-found: Expression.isOK/error via Layer.fields[..].expression for an 'expression health' readout, RenderStreamModuleBase.mode/sceneName/animationSpeed as writable RenderStream-layer knobs.

55/55 supported. Doc-verified on screen2:screen_1 and projector:"projector 1": description, offset (with partial-JSON set), rotation, scale, master_fade, holdOutput, renderLayer, alpha, blendMode, content, resolution, mesh.description, tracking flags, parent, isInActiveStage(), isInError, locked, isConnected, needsContent(0), projectorViewBlending, screenBackground, projectors list, render_mode, autoSoftEdge, feather, lumens, screens list, plus getByUID(<uid>)/master_fade. Gaps: 'ledscreen:', 'dmxscreen:' and 'stage:' appear in zero fetched pages (grep count 0) so every LedScreen/DmxScreen/Stage candidate stays inferred (getByUID is the documented fallback); the module's own HELP.md nevertheless advertises 'ledscreen:myledscreen' and no researcher weighed that. Setting a scalar sub-field (object.offset.x with a number) is undocumented - the documented method is subscribing object.offset and sending {x: 4.0} - yet HELP.md's 'Set to Disguise (Number)' example uses object.offset.x. Vec2/Mat/Colour/ColourShift JSON shapes and Display.alpha range (float vs 255) are unknown.

gapsByCategory.status: NO doc-verified device-variable candidate; entire category inferred
gapsByCategory.detail: All 13 expressionvariablesdevice:<name> candidates are inferred: the prefix is evidenced only by the generic type:name rule (and the mididevice:bcf2000 precedent); the only doc-verified route is getByUID(<device uid>)/object.container.variables[<i>].defaultFloat for READ, with set-through-list-subscript untested (LiveUpdate documents set only through .sequence.key(0).v). By-name comprehension reads are not settable (writable corrected to no). Whether defaultFloat/defaultString are the LIVE value for device variables rests on one useful-strings snippet (pyi UserName is 'Default'; the layer help describes 'default' as a reset value). ExpressionVariable/ReflectionValue are _BlipValues with undocumented JSON serialisation. Function-type variables' expression text location unknown. Also flagged: useful-strings uses a class-cased path 'objects/ExpressionVariablesDevice/...' contradicting the 'always lowercase' rule, and the devices guide's device.enabled does not exist in the r34.0 stub. The doc-verified 'quick numeric knobs' in this dimension are actually transport brightness/volume, screen master_fade/offset, projector offset and layer keyframe values - i.e. they belong to other categories.

gapsByCategory.detail: 40/41 supported. Doc-verified: getWorkloadReceiveStatuses(id), getStreamReceiveStatuses(id,"machine"), getWorkloadInstances(id), getWorkloadInstance(id,i).health() and its chained message/status, per-instance machineName/isProcessRunning/isDroppingFrames/isDroppingInputFrames/isHighActiveLatencyDetected/unrecoverableError/status, getWorkloadLayers(), activeLatency(), getLicensingState(), isEnabled, textureParamStatus().receivers(id), Machine hasTakenOverFailedMachine(). gapsByCategory.status: doc-verified per named machine; anything director-relative is inferred
gapsByCategory.detail: fo-01..fo-20 doc-verified on Machine:"<name>" / getByUID: hasTakenOverFailedMachine(), failed, failoverDisabled, networkConnected, networkStatus (enum undocumented), active, role (enum mapping inferred from class constants; MachineRole type has no pyi class), runningAs (semantics inferred), targets, hostname (has setter), IP_address, name, typeName, isGuiVisible, nodeId, getNetworkAdaptors(), d3ProjectsFolder, status(). fo-21..fo-43 (subsystem:D3NetManagerSystem, subsystem:SessionSystem, module globals d3NetManager/state, ReleaseVersion static calls on '<any resolvable object>') are all inferred: the LiveUpdate doc only demonstrates subsystem:MonitoringManager and subsystem:RenderStreamSystem and says 'all Designer types are available', not globals. Gaps: no documented way to name 'the local machine' or 'the director' without a live test; failover COMMANDS (cmdMachineFailed/Restored) must never be placed in a propertyPath and are REST-only; which machine evaluates expressions when Companion is pointed at a non-Director is unknown; d3NetManager.timeout units and 'currentPreset' counterpart unknown. Verifier-found high-value extras on the doc-verified prefix: allRequiredOutputsGenlocked(), syncStatus(iSlot), vfcPTPLockState(iSlot), vfcTemperature(iSlot), vfcSysAlertMissingGenlock(), slotsWithInvalidSFPState(), MachineStatus.tUpdated, SessionDiscoverySystem.getSessionAPIEndpoint().

gapsByCategory.status: not researched by any dimension; depends on companion_api findings
gapsByCategory.detail: No path dimension addressed templates. Relevant verified companion_api facts: presets carry feedback+action on the same button (established); textExpression in style is supported since module-base 1.9.0 (installed 1.13.2, requires Companion >= 4.1 per the README compatibility table); previewStyle honours text/size/alignment/pngalignment/color/png64/bgcolor/textExpression but not show_topbar, is an always-true check_expression feedback and is not copied to placed buttons; categories sort alphabetically with definitions kept in in-category order; omitted preset options get no default fallback; $(label:var) references are rewritten to the user's connection label only inside textinput fields with useVariables or expression fields (Variables/Util.ts:98-101) and unconditionally in style layers, so a $(liveupdate:...) placed in an option WITHOUT useVariables (e.g. variableName, or a set-action value field if it lacks useVariables) breaks on connection rename. Not yet checked by anyone: which of the module's feedback/action option fields declare useVariables (src/feedbacks.ts lines 28-52 show four textinput/number options; flags not inspected here), and whether the existing presets.ts style (updateFrequency: 0, connectionState stacked) should be the template baseline.

blockingQuestions: Type-prefix casing and quoting for object paths: docs show transportManager:default (plugin guide, HELP.md), transportmanager:default (help accessing-resources), Machine:"<name>" (LiveUpdate doc), lowercase-only 'always lowercase' paths (resources guide) and class-cased useful-strings paths; and(x,y)/or(x,y) are functions not infix operators. The catalog cannot fix a canonical spelling without one live test per casing on r34.0.3.

Does subsystem:<ClassName> resolve for every Subsystem subclass (D3NetManagerSystem, SessionSystem, GuiSystem) or only for the two documented ones (MonitoringManager, RenderStreamSystem)? This gates all director-relative failover presets (fo-21..fo-35), tr-48 and every 'local machine' readout.

Are module globals (d3NetManager, state, paths) and bare type names (ReleaseVersion, ExpressionVariable.FloatType, MetricGraphCategories) available inside a LiveUpdate property path? The doc says 'all Designer types are available (via from d3 import *)' - types, not globals. Gates fo-17, fo-22, fo-38..fo-43, mon-categories.

Expression-variable path: does 'expressionvariablesdevice:<name>' resolve, and does a LiveUpdate set through object.container.variables[<i>].defaultFloat write the live value? Until answered the whole Expression Variables category has zero shippable presets; getByUID read is the only doc-verified fallback.

Monitor-name list: only fps, GPUProfiler, CPU, GPUMemory, ProcessMemory (guide) and Machine, Disk (Grafana) are evidenced; Output Latency, Frame Latency, PCI/CPU IO, Timer and the RenderStream graphs have no known findLocalMonitor name. Needs the discovery expression [m.name for m in object.localMonitors().all()] run live, plus [s.name for s in object.graphDescriptor(False).dataSeries] per monitor to confirm series titles, plus a unit check for CPU 'Total' (ms vs percent).

Transport reachability details: tRender vs tCurrent (which one the timeline readout follows), PlayMode.__str__() literal strings, JSON shape of object.player.playMode, whether a LiveUpdate set on object.brightness/volume/engaged (and TrackPlayer.mode) behaves like a TransportCommand, and how to express a boolean 'TC locked' (no pyi member matches REST receivingTimecode).

Set semantics beyond the single documented example: scalar sub-field sets (object.offset.x - advertised in HELP.md but undocumented), set through list subscripts/comprehensions, set on a live Module field vs keyframe, set on locked resources, and whether a set on a Subsystem-rooted (non-Resource) path such as MonitoringManager.searchString is accepted.

Track/layer stub-vs-doc conflicts requiring a live test before any layer preset ships: getLeafLayers() with no argument on a Track, nKeys vs nKeys(), layer-by-name via track:<t>.findLayerByName("..") in the object path, and track:"Track 1" quoting. HELP.md's 'track:track_1 / object.enabled' Boolean example must be re-checked: d3.pyi 47975-50140 shows no 'enabled' on SuperTrack/Track, only enableRender(onOff).

RenderStream workload discovery: the workload ID (int, decimal or hex?) is only obtainable via REST or the widget's Copy UID, which the module cannot call; and enum meanings for WorkloadInstance.status / WorkloadHealth.status / priority are undocumented, so button colours cannot be mapped without a live capture.

Error/throttle behaviour that shapes preset defaults: what the {error} reply looks like for an unknown monitor/name/index (the module auto-unsubscribes after 3 consecutive path errors per HELP.md, so a preset with a placeholder name will self-disable), whether computed expressions (method calls, comprehensions) are re-evaluated per updateFrequency cycle rather than change-driven, and confirmation that updateFrequency 0 must be banned for monitors and transport playhead (the shipped presets.ts uses 0).

Which machine evaluates expressions when the Companion connection targets a non-Director, and whether remote monitors require MonitoringManager.useMonitorByName(nodeName, monitorName, True) on the Director before data flows.

Module-level Templates question: which option fields in src/feedbacks.ts / src/actions.ts declare useVariables (Companion only rewrites $(liveupdate:...) inside useVariables textinput or expression fields on connection rename), and whether textExpression styles are acceptable given the module-base 1.13.2 -> Companion >= 4.1 floor.
sourcesNotConsulted: osc-help.md (companion-module-disguise-osc HELP): no dimension referenced it. It is the natural feature-parity checklist - variables currentSectionName, nextSectionName, heartbeat, playMode, section time elapsed/remaining, sectionHint, timecode position (+h/m/s/f), trackid, track name, track position (+h/m/s/f), master volume, master brightness, bpm; presets play/play section/loop section/stop/prev-next section/return to start/prev-next track/fade up-down/hold/volume-brightness steps; feedbacks heartbeat/playmode/volume=0/brightness=0. Its TASKS list ('Add presets for information received from Disguise e.g. section name, timecode position') is exactly what this LiveUpdate library can deliver read-only.

The module's own companion/HELP.md and src/presets.ts as evidence targets: transport cited HELP.md lines 211-213 for tRender, but nobody cross-checked HELP.md's other examples against the research (track:track_1 + object.enabled Boolean set - no such member in d3.pyi; ledscreen:myledscreen - undocumented prefix; object.offset.x as a Number set target - undocumented scalar sub-field set; screen2:surface_1 vs doc's screen2:screen_1), nor the existing presets.ts pattern (updateFrequency: 0 everywhere, connectionState feedback stacked with a green style).

src/feedbacks.ts 'connectionState' feedback and src/variables.ts 'connection_status' - omitted from the MODULE FACTS handed to researchers, so the Connection & Status category was never mapped to them.

A live Designer r34.0.3 session: no dimension performed any live probe; every 'inferred' item and all blocking questions above are resolvable only by roughly a dozen subscribe messages against a real Director.
recommendations: Phase 1 catalog: ship only doc-verified rows by default and gate every inferred row behind an explicit 'Experimental' category (or a suffix in the preset name) so a self-disabling PATH_ERROR does not look like a module bug; put the exprvars device-variable presets, all ledscreen:/dmxscreen:/stage: presets, and all director-relative failover presets in that experimental tier.

Before freezing the catalog, run a single live smoke-test script of ~12 subscriptions on r34.0.3 that resolves the blockers in one sitting: prefix casing (transportManager vs transportmanager vs Machine vs machine), subsystem:D3NetManagerSystem/object.isEnabled, d3NetManager.localMachine.name and state.projectName from any object, expressionvariablesdevice:<name>/object.description, [m.name for m in object.localMonitors().all()], per-monitor series names, CPU 'Total' value magnitude, track:track_1.getLeafLayers()[0]/object.name, .sequence.nKeys vs nKeys(), object.player.playMode.__str__() strings, a set on transportManager:default/object.brightness, and a set on screen2:<name>/object.offset.x.

Resolve the module:<layer> contradiction: either downgrade exprvars 'knob-layer-module-brightness' to inferred (consistent with track_layer's rejection of 'module:' as a LiveUpdate object path) or upgrade both after the live test; do not ship one as doc-verified while the other is rejected.

Correct HELP.md before the preset library references it: replace the 'track:track_1 / object.enabled' Boolean example with a layer example (track:track_1.getLeafLayers()[0] / object.enabled, r33.1+), mark 'ledscreen:' and 'object.offset.x set' as untested, and align screen2:surface_1 vs screen2:screen_1 naming with the LiveUpdate doc.

Set updateFrequency defaults per class of value and never 0 for monitors or playhead: 500 ms fps/GPU/CPU readouts, 1000 ms rolling averages, RenderStream instance state and transport state strings, 100-250 ms only for tRender-based countdowns, 2000-5000 ms memory and identity strings, 10000+ ms discovery lists; fix the existing presets.ts rows that use 0.

Use osc-help.md as the parity checklist for the Transport category: map each OSC variable to its read-only LiveUpdate candidate (currentSectionName->tr-25, nextSectionName->findBeatOfNextSection-based variant of tr-26, playMode->tr-05/06, section elapsed/remaining->tr-29/tr-28, timecode->tr-34, track name->tr-20, track position->tr-01/03/04, master volume/brightness->tr-16/15, bpm->tr-23, heartbeat->connection_status), and state explicitly in the library README that OSC-style transport ACTIONS (play/stop/next section, fades) are not available over LiveUpdate and require REST POST /api/session/transport/* - consider a future HTTP action in the module rather than faking them.

For Templates, inspect src/feedbacks.ts and src/actions.ts option flags and ensure every option that may contain $(liveupdate:...) or $(custom:...) is a textinput with useVariables: true; keep textExpression styles (module-base 1.9+, installed 1.13.2) but document the Companion >= 4.1 floor; do not rely on previewStyle for show_topbar.

Add the verifier-found doc-verified members to the catalog rather than leaving them in 'missed': Machine.allRequiredOutputsGenlocked()/hasIncomingHouseSyncSignal()/syncStatus(iSlot)/vfcPTPLockState(iSlot)/vfcTemperature(iSlot) (health page), TransportManager.monitorString/sendTransportCommands/on_clock_lost/smpteClockType()/findBeatOfNextSection() (transport page), SuperTransportManager.volume (knob), RenderStreamModuleBase.mode/sceneName and StreamObject.isStreamOnline (RenderStream page), Resource.descriptionExtended (status label on any object).

Treat every Vec/struct subscription as JSON and give templates a Companion expression to extract fields (jsonparse), because Vec2/Mat/Colour/_BlipValue struct shapes are undocumented; prefer scalar propertyPaths (object.offset.x for READ is doc-verified) where a single number is wanted.

Document the Python 2.7 constraint (verified on the environment page) in every template's help text: no f-strings, use %-formatting, False/True capitalised, comprehensions fine, never call mutating methods (setFloat, cmdMachineFailed, startWorkload) inside a propertyPath.
